description: Optional landscape variants for the illustrative weather hero. These are generic scenes, not city photographs or live observations.
notes: Coastal and urban are real-world overlapping properties; the default policy gives a known coastal setting priority over urban scenery.
Do not infer countryside merely because a location is not recognized as urban.
If the landscape category is uncertain, use the neutral fallback and expose the user's landscape preference control.
Replace {condition} and {phase} only after the normalizer has validated them against the arrays above.
